questions.stem: The basic difference between a master budget and a flexible budget is that a master budget is

choices.label: A
choices.text: Only used before and during the budget period and a flexible budget is only used after the budget period

choices.label: B
choices.text: For an entire production facility and a flexible budget is applicable to single departments only

choices.label: C
choices.text: Based on one specific level of production and a flexible budget can be prepared for any production level within a relevant range

choices.label: D
choices.text: Based on a fixed standard and a flexible budget allows management latitude in meeting goals

questions.explanation: A master budget is built on one planned level of activity, so comparing it with actual results at a different volume mixes up price and efficiency effects with the simple fact that volume differed. A flexible budget is recalculated at whatever level was actually achieved within the relevant range, which isolates the performance question.
questions.explanationJa: 総合予算（master budget）は一つの計画操業度を前提に組まれるので、これを異なる操業度の実績と比べると、価格や能率の影響と、単に数量が違ったという事実とが混ざってしまう。変動予算（flexible budget）は、関連範囲内で実際に達成された水準に合わせて組み直されるので、業績の問題だけを取り出せる。

questions.stem: Which of the following is a disadvantage of participative budgeting?
questions.explanation: Participative budgeting brings managers at every level into the process, which takes negotiation and iteration and therefore time. Its benefits run the other way from the wrong answers: involvement raises motivation, acceptance, and accuracy, since the people closest to the work know their costs best.
questions.explanationJa: 参加型予算はあらゆる階層の管理者を編成過程に巻き込むので、調整と反復に時間がかかる。その利点は誤答が述べる方向とは逆である。関与することで動機づけも受容度も精度も高まる。業務に最も近い人々こそ自らの原価を最もよく知っているからである。

questions.stem:
Ryan Co. projects the following monthly revenues for next year:
January | $100,000
February | 500,000
March | 425,000
April | 450,000
May | 575,000
June | 300,000
July | 250,000
August | 275,000
September | 300,000
October | 350,000
November | 400,000
December | 525,000
Ryan's terms are net 30 days. The company typically receives payment on 80% of sales the month following the sale, and 17% is collected two months after the sale. Approximately 3% of sales are deemed bad debt. What amount represents the expected cash collection in the second calendar quarter of next year?
questions.explanation: Each month's collections come from the two preceding months: 80% of last month's sales and 17% of the month before. April = (80% x $425,000) + (17% x $500,000) = $425,000; May = (80% x $450,000) + (17% x $425,000) = $432,250; June = (80% x $575,000) + (17% x $450,000) = $536,500. Second-quarter total = $1,393,750. The 3% never arrives, so it is simply omitted rather than deducted at the end.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a characteristic of a flexible budget?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Provides budgeted numbers for various activity levels

choices.label: B
choices.text: Allows for modification during the budgeted period

choices.label: C
choices.text: Isolates the impact of variable costs on the overall budget

choices.label: D
choices.text: Can be utilized by several product divisions

questions.explanation: A flexible budget is a formula, fixed cost plus variable cost per unit, so it can generate a budget at any activity level. That is what lets actual results be compared with what should have been spent at the volume actually achieved.
questions.explanationJa: 変動予算は「固定費 + 単位当たり変動費」という数式なので、どの操業度に対しても予算額を生成できる。これによって、実際に達成した数量のもとで本来いくら使うべきだったかと実績を比較できるようになる。

questions.stem: Which of the following listings correctly describes the order in which the four types of budgets must be prepared?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Production, direct materials purchases, sales, cash disbursements

choices.label: B
choices.text: Sales, production, direct materials purchases, cash disbursements

choices.label: C
choices.text: Cash disbursements, direct materials purchases, production, sales

choices.label: D
choices.text: Sales, direct materials purchases, production, cash disbursements

questions.explanation: Everything follows from sales. The sales budget sets how many units are needed, production converts that into units to be made after allowing for inventory, materials purchases follow from the production plan, and cash disbursements come last because they depend on when the purchases and other costs are paid.
questions.explanationJa: すべては販売予算から始まる。販売予算が必要数量を定め、生産予算が在庫を考慮して製造数量に変換し、材料購入予算が生産計画から導かれ、現金支出予算は最後に来る。購入その他の費用がいつ支払われるかに依存するからである。

questions.stem:
Controllable revenue would be included in a performance report for a
Profit center | Cost center
questions.explanation: A profit center's manager is accountable for both revenues and costs, so revenue belongs in the report. A cost center's manager controls only costs and has no authority over pricing or sales volume, so charging that manager with revenue would measure something outside their control.
questions.explanationJa: プロフィットセンターの管理者は収益と原価の両方に責任を負うので、収益は業績報告書に含まれる。コストセンターの管理者は原価しか管理しておらず、価格設定や販売数量に権限がないので、収益の責任を負わせることは、その管理者の統制外の事象を評価することになる。

questions.stem: Wages earned by machine operators in producing the firm's product should be categorized as Controllable by the Direct labor machine operators' foreman
questions.explanation: Machine operators work directly on the product, so their wages are direct labour. The foreman schedules those operators and their hours, so the cost is controllable at that level, even though it is not controllable by the operators themselves.
questions.explanationJa: 機械オペレーターは製品に直接作業するので、その賃金は直接労務費である。職長はそのオペレーターの配置と作業時間を決めるので、この原価は職長の階層では管理可能である。オペレーター自身にとっては管理不能であっても、である。

questions.stem: Which of the following statements is correct regarding financial decision making?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Opportunity cost is recorded as a normal business expense.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The accounting rate of return considers the time value of money.

choices.label: C
choices.text: A strength of the payback method is that it is based on profitability.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Capital budgeting is based on predictions of an uncertain future.

questions.explanation: Capital budgeting rests on forecasts of cash flows years ahead, which is why sensitivity and probability analysis accompany it. The others are all false: opportunity cost is never recorded in the accounts, the accounting rate of return ignores the time value of money, and the payback method measures liquidity rather than profitability.
questions.explanationJa: 資本予算は何年も先のキャッシュフローの予測に立脚しており、だからこそ感度分析や確率分析が併用される。他の3つはいずれも誤りである。機会費用は帳簿に記録されず、会計的利益率は貨幣の時間価値を無視し、回収期間法が測るのは収益性ではなく流動性である。

questions.stem: Which of the following forecasting methods relies mostly on judgment?
questions.explanation: The Delphi method collects forecasts from a panel of experts through successive rounds of anonymous feedback until the estimates converge. It uses no historical data at all, which is precisely why it suits situations where such data does not exist. The other three are all statistical techniques fitted to past observations.
questions.explanationJa: デルファイ法は、匿名のフィードバックを何巡か重ねて専門家パネルから予測を集め、推定値を収束させていく手法である。過去データを一切使わないが、それこそがデータの存在しない状況に適する理由である。他の3つはいずれも過去の観測値に当てはめる統計的手法である。

questions.stem:
Using regression analysis, Fairfield Co. graphed the following relationship of its cheapest product line's sales with its customers' income levels:
If there is a strong statistical relationship between the sales and customers' income levels, which of the following numbers best represents the correlation coefficient for this relationship?
questions.explanation: A correlation coefficient is always between -1 and +1, which eliminates the two answers of magnitude 9 immediately. For the cheapest product line, sales fall as customer income rises, since better-off customers trade up, so the relationship is strong and negative: -0.93.
questions.explanationJa: 相関係数は必ず −1 から +1 の間に収まるので、絶対値9の2つの選択肢は直ちに排除できる。最も安価な製品ラインでは、顧客の所得が上がるほど売上が下がる。豊かになった顧客は上位の製品へ移るからである。したがって関係は強い負の相関、すなわち −0.93 となる。

questions.stem: Multiple regression differs from simple regression in that it

choices.label: C
choices.text: Allows the computation of the coefficient of determination

questions.explanation: Multiple regression explains one dependent variable using two or more independent variables, each with its own coefficient. There is always exactly one dependent variable, and both forms produce an intercept and a coefficient of determination.
questions.explanationJa: 重回帰分析は、2つ以上の独立変数を用いて1つの従属変数を説明し、各独立変数にそれぞれの係数が与えられる。従属変数は常にちょうど1つであり、切片も決定係数も単回帰・重回帰の双方で算出される。

questions.stem:
To determine the best cost driver of warranty costs relating to glass breakage during shipments, Wymer Co. used simple linear regression analysis to study the relationship between warranty costs and each of the following variables: type of packaging, quantity shipped, type of carrier, and distance shipped. The analysis yielded the following statistics:
Independent | Coefficient of | Standard Error of
variable | Determination | Regression
Type of packaging | 0.60 | 1,524
Quantity shipped | 0.48 | 1,875
Type of carrier | 0.45 | 2,149
Distance shipped | 0.20 | 4,876
Based on these analyses, the best driver of warranty costs for glass breakage is
questions.explanation: The coefficient of determination shows how much of the variation in warranty cost each variable explains, and the standard error shows how tightly the observations cluster around the fitted line. Type of packaging wins on both counts, with the highest R squared at 0.60 and the smallest standard error at 1,524, so it is the best driver.
questions.explanationJa: 決定係数は、各変数が保証費用の変動をどれだけ説明できるかを示し、標準誤差は観測値が回帰直線の周りにどれだけ密集しているかを示す。梱包の種類は両方の観点で最良であり、決定係数が最も高く0.60、標準誤差が最も小さく1,524なので、最も適したドライバーとなる。

questions.stem: A management accountant performs a linear regression of maintenance cost vs. production using a computer spreadsheet. The regression output shows an "intercept" value of $322,897. How should the accountant interpret this information?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Y has a value of $322,897 when X equals zero.

choices.label: B
choices.text: X has a value of $322,897 when Y equals zero.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The residual error of the regression is $322,897.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Maintenance cost has an average value of $322,897.

questions.explanation: In Y = a + bX the intercept a is the value of Y when X is zero, so $322,897 is the estimated maintenance cost at zero production, that is, the fixed component. Read literally it is an extrapolation outside the observed data, so it is best treated as the fixed cost estimate rather than a prediction of an actual shutdown month.
questions.explanationJa: Y = a + bX において切片 a は X がゼロのときの Y の値なので、$322,897 は生産量ゼロにおける保全費の推定値、すなわち固定費部分である。文字どおりに読めば観測データの外側への外挿にあたるので、実際に操業停止した月の予測値ではなく、固定費の推定値として扱うのが適切である。

questions.stem: Probability (risk) analysis is

choices.label: A
choices.text: Used only for situations involving five or fewer possible outcomes

choices.label: B
choices.text: Used only for situations in which the summation of probability weights is greater than one

questions.explanation: Sensitivity analysis asks what happens if an input changes; probability analysis goes one step further by attaching a likelihood to each outcome, so the results can be weighted into an expected value and a measure of dispersion. The two are complementary, not alternatives.
questions.explanationJa: 感度分析は「ある入力が変化したら何が起きるか」を問う。確率分析はそこから一歩進んで各結果に発生確率を付すので、結果を加重して期待値とばらつきの尺度を求められる。両者は代替関係ではなく補完関係にある。

questions.stem: Which tool would most likely be used to determine the best course of action under conditions of uncertainly?
questions.explanation: Uncertainty means several outcomes are possible with known or estimated probabilities. Expected value multiplies each outcome by its probability and sums them, giving a single figure by which alternatives can be ranked. The other three assume the outcome is known.
questions.explanationJa: 不確実性とは、複数の結果が起こりえて、それぞれに既知または推定された確率が付いている状態である。期待値は各結果にその確率を掛けて合計し、代替案を順位づけできる単一の数値を与える。他の3つは結果が確定していることを前提とした手法である。

questions.stem: In probability analysis, the square root of the mean of the squared differences between the observed values and the expected value is the
questions.explanation: That description is the definition of standard deviation, the square root of the variance. In risk analysis it measures how widely the possible outcomes are spread around the expected value, so two alternatives with the same expected value can still differ sharply in risk.
questions.explanationJa: この記述は標準偏差の定義そのものであり、分散の平方根にあたる。リスク分析においては、起こりうる結果が期待値の周りにどれだけ広く散らばっているかを測るので、期待値が同じ2つの代替案でもリスクが大きく異なりうることを示せる。

questions.stem:
Under frost-free conditions, Cal Cultivators expects its strawberry crop to have a $60,000 market value.
An unprotected crop subject to frost has an expected market value of $40,000. If Cal protects the strawberries against frost, then the market value of the crop is still expected to be $60,000 under frost- free conditions and $90,000 if there is a frost. What must be the probability of a frost for Cal to be indifferent to spending $10,000 for frost protection?
questions.explanation: Let p be the probability of frost. Without protection the expected value is $60,000(1 - p) + $40,000p = $60,000 - $20,000p. With protection it is $60,000(1 - p) + $90,000p - $10,000 = $50,000 + $30,000p. Setting them equal gives $10,000 = $50,000p, so p = 0.20. Below that probability the $10,000 is not worth spending.
questions.explanationJa: 霜が降りる確率を p とする。防護しない場合の期待値は $60,000(1 − p) + $40,000p = $60,000 − $20,000p。防護する場合は $60,000(1 − p) + $90,000p − $10,000 = $50,000 + $30,000p。両者を等しいと置くと $10,000 = $50,000p となり、p = 0.20。これを下回る確率であれば $10,000 を支出する価値はない。

questions.stem:
Rework costs should be regarded as a cost of quality in a manufacturing company's quality control program when they are
I. Caused by the customer
II. Caused by internal failure
questions.explanation: Cost of quality covers what the producer spends because its own process was imperfect. Rework needed because the item was made wrong is an internal failure cost. Rework caused by the customer, such as a change of specification, is a chargeable service, not a quality failure of the manufacturer.
questions.explanationJa: 品質原価が対象とするのは、自社の工程が不完全だったために生産者が負担する支出である。製造の不備によって必要となった手直しは内部失敗コストにあたる。顧客に起因する手直し、たとえば仕様変更による作り直しは、有償の役務であって製造者の品質上の失敗ではない。

questions.stem:
Key Co. changed from a traditional manufacturing operation with a job order costing system to a just-in- time operation with a back-flush costing system. What is(are) the expected effect(s) of these changes on Key's inspection costs and recording detail of costs tracked to jobs in process?
Inspection costs | Detail of costs tracked to jobs
questions.explanation: JIT works with certified suppliers and quality built into the process, so the volume of separate inspection falls. Backflush costing skips the intermediate work in process entries and charges cost only at completion or sale, so the detail tracked to jobs falls as well.
questions.explanationJa: JITは認定された供給業者と、工程に作り込まれた品質のもとで運用されるので、個別の検査量は減少する。バックフラッシュ原価計算は仕掛品の中間仕訳を省き、完成時または販売時にまとめて原価を賦課するので、指図書ごとに追跡する明細も減少する。

questions.stem: Which of the following balanced scorecard perspectives examines a company's success in targeted market segments?
questions.explanation: The customer perspective measures how the company is doing in the markets it has chosen to compete in, through indicators such as market share, customer retention, acquisition, satisfaction, and profitability by segment.
questions.explanationJa: 顧客の視点は、自社が競争の場として選んだ市場でどれだけうまくやれているかを、市場シェア・顧客維持率・新規獲得・満足度・セグメント別収益性といった指標で測る。

questions.stem:
Smart Co. uses a static budget. When actual sales are less than budget, Smart would report favorable variances on which of the following expense categories?
Sales commissions | Building rent
questions.explanation: A static budget is not adjusted for the shortfall in volume. Sales commissions vary with sales, so actual commissions fall below the budgeted amount and the variance looks favorable, though it merely reflects lower sales. Building rent is fixed and unaffected by volume, so there is no variance at all.
questions.explanationJa: 固定予算は数量の未達に合わせて修正されない。販売手数料は売上に連動するので、実際額は予算額を下回り、差異は有利に見える。もっともそれは売上が少なかったことの裏返しにすぎない。建物賃借料は固定費で数量の影響を受けないので、差異は生じない。

questions.stem:
To measure inventory management performance, a company monitors its inventory turnover ratio. Listed below are selected data from the company's accounting records:
Current year | Prior year
Annual sales | $2,525,000 | $2,125,000
Gross profit percent | 40% | 35%
Beginning finished goods inventory for the current year was 15% of the prior-year's annual sales, and ending finished goods inventory was 22% of the current-year's annual sales. What was the company's inventory turnover at the end of the current period?
questions.explanation: Cost of goods sold = $2,525,000 x (1 - 40%) = $1,515,000. Beginning inventory = 15% x $2,125,000 = $318,750 and ending inventory = 22% x $2,525,000 = $555,500, so average inventory = $437,125. Turnover = $1,515,000 / $437,125 = 3.47. Using sales instead of cost of goods sold in the numerator would overstate the ratio.

questions.stem: The management of a company would do which of the following to compare and contrast its financial information to published information reflecting optimal amounts?
questions.explanation: Benchmarking is the comparison of one's own measures with an external standard representing the best achievable level. A budget and a forecast are both internally generated expectations, and adopting best practices is what a company does after benchmarking reveals the gap.
questions.explanationJa: ベンチマーキングとは、自社の指標を、達成可能な最高水準を表す外部の基準と比較することである。予算も予測も社内で作られた期待値にすぎず、ベストプラクティスの採用は、ベンチマーキングによって差が明らかになった後に企業が行うことである。

questions.stem: What characteristic would most likely not be a best practice for an accounting department?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Have the accounting department originate transactions

choices.label: C
choices.text: Treat geographically dispersed resources as one

choices.label: D
choices.text: Data entry controls seek zero-defect information through the use of limits and ranges

questions.explanation: Accounting records transactions; it should not originate them, because doing so destroys the segregation between initiating a transaction and recording it, and leaves no independent check on the accounting figures. The other three are recognized best practices.
questions.explanationJa: 経理は取引を記録する部門であって、取引を起こす部門であってはならない。それを行えば、取引の開始と記録の職務分離が失われ、会計数値に対する独立した牽制がなくなるからである。他の3つはいずれも認められたベストプラクティスである。

questions.stem: Which of the following definitions best characterizes benchmarking?

choices.label: A
choices.text: A technique that examines product and process attributes to identify areas for improvements

choices.label: B
choices.text: The comparison of existing activities with the best levels of performance in order, similar organizations

choices.label: C
choices.text: The development of the most effective methods of completing tasks in a particular industry

choices.label: D
choices.text: The complete redesign of a process within an organization

questions.explanation: Benchmarking compares existing activities with the best levels of performance found in comparable organizations, so the reference point comes from outside. Choice A describes value analysis, choice C the development of best practices, and choice D reengineering.
questions.explanationJa: ベンチマーキングは、現行の活動を、比較可能な組織で見られる最高の業績水準と比べるものであり、基準点は外部から得られる。選択肢Aは価値分析、選択肢Cはベストプラクティスの開発、選択肢Dはリエンジニアリングの説明である。

questions.stem: What is least characteristic of a learning organization?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Ability to learn from its own experience as well as that of others

questions.explanation: A learning organization keeps questioning its own methods, which requires room to experiment and to depart from established procedure. Rigid insistence on existing policy is the opposite: it preserves the current way of working and shuts off the feedback that learning depends on.
questions.explanationJa: 学習する組織は自らのやり方を問い続けるので、実験する余地と、確立された手順から逸脱する余地を必要とする。既存の方針への厳格な固守はその対極にある。現在のやり方を温存し、学習が依拠するフィードバックを遮断してしまうからである。

questions.stem: Which of the following generally is considered the least beneficial result of strategic management?
questions.explanation: The value of strategic management lies in the thinking it forces: looking ahead, reading a changing environment, and forming a shared vision. The written plan is only the record of that thinking, and it dates quickly, so it is the least beneficial of the four results.
questions.explanationJa: 戦略的マネジメントの価値は、それが強いる思考にある。先を見据えること、変化する環境を読むこと、共有されたビジョンを形成することである。文書化された戦略計画はその思考の記録にすぎず、しかもすぐに陳腐化するので、4つの成果のうち最も便益が小さい。

questions.stem: What is the typical link between two businesses being combined in a conglomerate diversification strategy?
questions.explanation: Conglomerate diversification combines businesses with nothing operational in common, so there is no shared customer base, distribution network, or technology. What links them is financial: an internal capital market, diversified earnings, and in some cases a tax or borrowing advantage.
questions.explanationJa: コングロマリット型多角化は、業務上の共通点を持たない事業同士を結合するので、顧客基盤も流通網も技術も共有されない。両者を結びつけるのは財務的な事柄である。内部資本市場、収益の分散、場合によっては税務上や借入上の優位がこれにあたる。

questions.stem: Which of the following steps in the strategic planning process should be completed first?
questions.explanation: The mission statement comes first because it defines what the entity exists to do; every later step is derived from it. Objectives are set to serve the mission, goals make the objectives concrete, actions deliver the goals, and performance measures track whether they were delivered.
questions.explanationJa: 使命の表明（mission statement）が最初に来る。それが組織の存在意義を定義し、以降のすべての段階がそこから導かれるからである。目的は使命に奉仕するために設定され、目標は目的を具体化し、行動計画が目標を実現し、業績指標がその達成度を追跡する。

questions.stem: What strategy involves increasing market share in the same industry?
questions.explanation: Horizontal growth expands within the same industry and the same stage of production, by taking share from rivals or acquiring them. Concentric growth moves into related industries, and conglomerate growth into unrelated ones.
questions.explanationJa: 水平的成長は、同一の産業・同一の生産段階の内側で拡大するものであり、競争相手からシェアを奪うか、競争相手を買収することで実現する。集中的（コンセントリック）成長は関連産業へ、コングロマリット型成長は無関連の産業へ進出する戦略である。

questions.stem: When introducing a unique product, Aviator Company sets a high price and gradually lowers it as all consumers who will purchase at each price have bought the product and competitors introduce similar products. Which of the following best describes this practice?
questions.explanation: Skim pricing starts high to capture the buyers who value the product most, then steps the price down through successively more price-sensitive segments as competition arrives. Penetration pricing is the mirror image, starting low to build volume and share quickly.
questions.explanationJa: 上澄み吸収価格（skim pricing）は、その製品を最も高く評価する買手を捉えるために高価格から始め、競争が現れるにつれて価格感応度の高い層へ順次価格を下げていく手法である。浸透価格（penetration pricing）はその裏返しで、低価格から始めて数量とシェアを一気に築く。

questions.stem: Aim Company manufactures residential windows. It has a long-term contract with only two glass suppliers who are involved in Aim's design process. What is the best description of this relationship?
questions.explanation: A long-term relationship with a small number of suppliers who take part in the buyer's design work is a value-chain partnership: the two firms coordinate across the boundary between them so that the whole chain, not just each link, is optimized. Nothing here restrains competition, so collusion is wrong.
questions.explanationJa: 少数の供給業者と長期的な関係を築き、その供給業者が買手の設計工程に参画する形態はバリューチェーン・パートナーシップである。2社が企業の境界をまたいで調整し、各段階ではなく連鎖全体を最適化する。競争を制限する要素はないので、談合（collusion）は誤りである。

questions.stem: Which of the following best describes an entity with a divisional entity structure?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Andy’s Puppies has one person supervising most employees and making most decisions.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Eve’s Exotics has a web of independent contractors instead of employees.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Fido & Friends has each employee report to both a functional and a product manager.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Pete’s Pets has multiple product lines and decentralized decision making.

questions.explanation: A divisional structure groups the organization by product, service, or geography, and pushes decisions down to the division that owns the results. Choice A is a simple structure, choice B a network or virtual structure, and choice C a matrix structure with dual reporting.
questions.explanationJa: 事業部制組織は、製品・サービス・地域によって組織を区分し、成果に責任を負う事業部へ意思決定を委ねる。選択肢Aは単純組織、選択肢Bはネットワーク型（バーチャル）組織、選択肢Cは二重の報告経路を持つマトリックス組織の説明である。

questions.stem:
Lanta Restaurant compares monthly operating results with a static budget. When actual sales are less than budget, would Lanta usually report favorable variances on variable food costs and fixed supervisory salaries?
Variable food costs | Fixed supervisory salaries
questions.explanation: A static budget is not restated for the lower volume. Variable food cost falls with sales, so the actual figure comes in under the unadjusted budget and shows as favorable, even though nothing was managed better. Supervisory salaries are fixed and do not move with volume, so no variance arises.
questions.explanationJa: 固定予算は数量の減少に合わせて組み直されない。変動費である食材費は売上に連動して減るので、修正されていない予算額を下回り、有利差異として表示される。実際には何もうまく管理されていなくても、である。監督者給与は固定費で数量に連動しないので、差異は生じない。

questions.stem: Which of the following would be most impacted by the use of the percentage of sales forecasting method for budgeting purposes?
questions.explanation: The percentage of sales method projects those balances that move spontaneously with sales volume. Accounts payable does, since more purchases mean more owed to suppliers. Mortgages, bonds, and common stock change only by an explicit financing decision.
questions.explanationJa: 売上高百分率法は、売上高に連動して自然に増減する残高を予測する手法である。買掛金はこれにあたる。仕入が増えれば供給業者への債務も増えるからである。抵当借入・社債・普通株式は、明示的な資金調達の意思決定によってのみ変動する。

questions.stem:
When production levels are expected to decline within a relevant range, and a flexible budget is used, what effect would be anticipated with respect to each of the following?
Variable costs per unit | Fixed costs per unit
questions.explanation: Within the relevant range the variable cost per unit is constant by definition, so it does not change. Total fixed cost is also constant, so spreading it over fewer units raises the fixed cost per unit. This is exactly why unit costs must not be used to predict the effect of a volume change.
questions.explanationJa: 関連範囲内では、単位当たり変動費は定義上一定なので変化しない。固定費の総額も一定なので、より少ない数量で割ることになり、単位当たり固定費は上昇する。数量変化の影響を予測するのに単位原価を使ってはならない理由がまさにこれである。

questions.stem:
Rolling Wheels purchases bicycle components in the month prior to assembling them into bicycles.
Assembly is scheduled one month prior to budgeted sales. Rolling pays 75% of component costs in the month of purchase and 25% of the costs in the following month. Component costs included in budgeted cost of sales are:
April | May | June | July | August
$5,000 | $6,000 | $7,000 | $8,000 | $8,000
What is Rolling's budgeted cash payments for components in May?
questions.explanation: Trace the lead times backwards. Components are bought one month before assembly, and assembly is one month before sale, so a purchase in month M supports sales two months later. May's purchases therefore cover July's $8,000 of sales and April's covered June's $7,000. Cash paid in May = (75% x $8,000) + (25% x $7,000) = $6,000 + $1,750 = $7,750.
questions.explanationJa: リードタイムを逆にたどる。部品は組立の1か月前に購入し、組立は販売の1か月前なので、ある月の購入は2か月後の販売に対応する。したがって5月の購入は7月の売上原価 $8,000 に、4月の購入は6月の $7,000 に対応する。5月の現金支払 = (75% × $8,000) + (25% × $7,000) = $6,000 + $1,750 = $7,750。

questions.stem:
Lanta Restaurant compares monthly operating results with a static budget. When actual sales are less than budget, would Lanta usually report favorable variances on variable food costs and fixed supervisory salaries?
Variable food costs | Fixed supervisory salaries
questions.explanation: The same logic as before: under a static budget the variable food cost falls with the shortfall in sales and therefore shows a favorable variance, while fixed supervisory salaries are unaffected by volume and produce no variance at all.
questions.explanationJa: 先の設問と同じ理屈である。固定予算のもとでは、変動費である食材費は売上の未達に応じて減るので有利差異として現れ、固定費である監督者給与は数量の影響を受けないので差異は生じない。

questions.stem: Which of the following budgets provides information for preparation of the owner's equity section of a budgeted balance sheet?
questions.explanation: Owner's equity moves with net income and dividends, and net income comes from the budgeted income statement. The sales budget is only an input to it, the cash budget deals with liquidity, and capital expenditures affect assets and financing rather than the equity section directly.
questions.explanationJa: 資本の部は当期純利益と配当によって変動し、その当期純利益は予算損益計算書から得られる。販売予算はその入力にすぎず、現金予算は流動性を扱い、設備投資予算は資本の部そのものではなく資産と資金調達に影響する。

questions.stem:
Crisper, Inc. plans to sell 80,000 bags of potato chips in June, and each of these bags requires five potatoes. Pertinent data includes:
Bags of Potato Chips | Potatoes
Actual June 1 inventory | 15,000 bags | 27,000 potatoes
Desired June 30 inventory | 18,000 bags | 23,000 potatoes
What number of units of raw material should Crisper plan to purchase?
questions.explanation: Two steps, each of the same shape. Bags to produce = 80,000 sold + 18,000 desired ending - 15,000 beginning = 83,000, needing 83,000 x 5 = 415,000 potatoes. Potatoes to purchase = 415,000 used + 23,000 desired ending - 27,000 beginning = 411,000. Skipping the potato inventory adjustment gives 415,000.
questions.explanationJa: 同じ形の計算を2段階行う。製造すべき袋数 = 販売80,000 + 期末在庫18,000 − 期首在庫15,000 = 83,000袋、必要なじゃがいもは 83,000 × 5 = 415,000個。購入すべきじゃがいも = 使用415,000 + 期末在庫23,000 − 期首在庫27,000 = 411,000個。じゃがいも在庫の調整を省くと415,000になる。

questions.stem:
In the past, four direct labor hours were required to produce each unit of product Y. Material costs were $200 per unit, the direct labor rate was $20 per hour, and factory overhead was three times direct labor cost. In budgeting for next year, management is planning to outsource some manufacturing activities and to further automate others. Management estimates these plans will reduce labor hours by 25%, increase the factory overhead rate to 3.6 times direct labor costs, and increase material costs by $30 per unit.
Management plans to manufacture 10,000 units. What amount should management budget for cost of goods manufactured?
questions.explanation: Rebuild the unit cost with all three changes. Labour hours = 4 x 75% = 3, so direct labour = 3 x $20 = $60. Overhead = 3.6 x $60 = $216. Materials = $200 + $30 = $230. Unit cost = $230 + $60 + $216 = $506, and 10,000 units gives $5,060,000. Note that the overhead rate applies to labour cost, not to hours.
questions.explanationJa: 3つの変更をすべて反映して単位原価を組み直す。作業時間 = 4 × 75% = 3時間なので、直接労務費 = 3 × $20 = $60。製造間接費 = 3.6 × $60 = $216。材料費 = $200 + $30 = $230。単位原価 = $230 + $60 + $216 = $506、10,000単位で $5,060,000。製造間接費率が掛かる相手は作業時間ではなく労務費である点に注意したい。

questions.stem: Which of the following inputs would be most beneficial to consider when management is developing the capital budget?

choices.label: B
choices.text: Current product sales prices and costs

questions.explanation: The capital budget is a list of proposed investments, and those proposals originate with the managers who know what equipment their operations need. Sales prices, demand, and wage trends are inputs to the operating budget and to the cash flow estimates within each proposal, but they do not generate the proposals themselves.
questions.explanationJa: 資本予算は投資提案の一覧であり、その提案は、自部門の業務にどの設備が必要かを知る管理者から生まれる。販売価格・需要・賃金の趨勢は、営業予算や各提案内のキャッシュフロー見積りへの入力ではあるが、提案そのものを生み出すものではない。

questions.stem:
The following is a summarized income statement of Carr Co.'s profit center No. 43 for December:
Contribution margin | $70,000
Period expenses:
Manager's salary | $20,000
Facility depreciation | 8,000
Corporate expense allocation | 5,000 | 33,000
Profit center income | $37,000
Which of the following amounts would most likely be subject to the control of the profit center's manager?
questions.explanation: A manager should be judged only on what he or she can influence. Contribution margin, driven by sales volume, price, and variable costs, is exactly that. The manager's own salary is set above, facility depreciation follows from an investment decision already made, and the corporate allocation is imposed from outside.
questions.explanationJa: 管理者は、自らが影響を及ぼしうる事柄によってのみ評価されるべきである。販売数量・価格・変動費によって決まる貢献利益がまさにそれにあたる。管理者自身の給与は上位者が決め、施設の減価償却費は既に行われた投資決定から生じ、本社費配賦は外部から課されるものである。

questions.stem: Which of the following may be used to estimate how inventory warehouse costs are affected by both the number of shipments and the weight of materials handled?
questions.explanation: Warehouse cost depends on two independent variables at once, the number of shipments and the weight handled. Multiple regression fits a separate coefficient to each, isolating their individual effects. Simple correlation could only measure one pairwise relationship at a time.
questions.explanationJa: 倉庫費用は、出荷回数と取扱重量という2つの独立変数に同時に依存する。重回帰分析はそれぞれに個別の係数を当てはめ、両者の効果を分離できる。単純相関では一度に1対1の関係しか測れない。

questions.stem: Kane Corp. estimates that it would incur a $100,000 cost to prepare a bid proposal. Kane estimates also that there would be an 80% chance of being awarded the contract if the bid is low enough to result in a net profit of $250,000. What is the expected value of the payoff?
questions.explanation: The $100,000 is spent whichever way it turns out, so the two branches are: win with 80% probability for a net profit of $250,000, or lose with 20% probability and be out the $100,000. Expected value = (0.80 x $250,000) + (0.20 x -$100,000) = $200,000 - $20,000 = $180,000.

questions.stem: In statistical analysis, a weighted average using probabilities as weights is the
questions.explanation: Expected value is the sum of each outcome multiplied by its probability, which is a weighted average with the probabilities as weights. Standard deviation measures dispersion around it, and the coefficient of variation scales that dispersion by the expected value.
questions.explanationJa: 期待値は、各結果にその発生確率を掛けて合計したものであり、確率をウェイトとする加重平均にほかならない。標準偏差はその周りのばらつきを測り、変動係数はそのばらつきを期待値で基準化したものである。

questions.stem: To assist in an investment decision, Gift Co. selected the most likely sales volume from several possible outcomes. Which of the following attributes would selected sales volume reflect?
questions.explanation: The most likely outcome is the one with the highest probability, which is the mode of the distribution. It need not coincide with the expected value or the median, and using it alone ignores the rest of the distribution, which is why it is a weaker basis for decision than expected value.
questions.explanationJa: 最も起こりやすい結果とは、発生確率が最も高い結果であり、分布の最頻値にあたる。期待値や中央値と一致するとは限らず、これだけを使えば分布の残りを無視することになる。意思決定の基礎として期待値より弱いのはそのためである。

questions.stem:
A vendor offered Wyatt Co. $25,000 compensation for losses resulting from faulty raw materials.
Alternately, a lawyer offered to represent Wyatt in a lawsuit against the vendor for a $12,000 retainer and 50% of any award over $35,000. Possible court awards with their associated probabilities are:
Award | Probability
$75,000 | 0.6
0 | 0.4
Compared to accepting the vendor's offer, the expected value for Wyatt to litigate the matter to verdict provides a
questions.explanation: Value each branch after the lawyer's cut. Win: $75,000 - $12,000 retainer - 50% x ($75,000 - $35,000) = $75,000 - $12,000 - $20,000 = $43,000. Lose: -$12,000, since the retainer is paid regardless. Expected value = (0.6 x $43,000) + (0.4 x -$12,000) = $25,800 - $4,800 = $21,000, which is $4,000 below the vendor's certain $25,000.

questions.stem:
During Year 1, Deet Corp. experienced the following power outages:
Number of outages per month | Number of months
0 | 3
1 | 2
2 | 4
3 | 3
12 Each power outage results in out-of-pocket costs of $400. For $500 per month, Deet can lease an auxiliary generator to provide power during outages. If Deet leases an auxiliary generator in Year 2, the estimated savings (or additional expenditures) for Year 2 would be
questions.explanation: Count the outages, not the months: (0 x 3) + (1 x 2) + (2 x 4) + (3 x 3) = 19 outages a year, costing 19 x $400 = $7,600. The generator costs $500 x 12 = $6,000, so leasing saves $1,600. Averaging the outages per month and multiplying is equivalent, but counting the total directly avoids a rounding step.
questions.explanationJa: 月数ではなく停電回数を数える: (0 × 3) + (1 × 2) + (2 × 4) + (3 × 3) = 年間19回、費用は 19 × $400 = $7,600。発電機の費用は $500 × 12 = $6,000 なので、リースすれば $1,600 の節約となる。月平均の停電回数を求めて掛けても同じだが、総数を直接数える方が丸めの手順を挟まずに済む。

questions.stem: Multiple regression analysis

choices.label: B
choices.text: Establishes a cause and effect relationship

choices.label: C
choices.text: Involves the use of independent variables only

questions.explanation: Regression output includes standard errors and confidence intervals, so it quantifies how much the estimates might be off. What it cannot do is establish causation: a high R squared shows association only. It uses both dependent and independent variables, and it is applied to sample data.
questions.explanationJa: 回帰分析の出力には標準誤差や信頼区間が含まれるので、推定値がどれだけ外れうるかを定量化できる。できないのは因果関係の立証である。決定係数が高くても示されるのは関連性だけである。また従属変数と独立変数の双方を用い、標本データに対して適用される手法である。

questions.stem: The regression analysis result for ABC Co. is shown as y = 90x + 45. The standard error (Sb) is 30 and coefficient of determination (r²) is 0.81. The budget calls for production of 100 units. What is ABC's estimate of total costs?
questions.explanation: Substitute the volume into the equation: y = 90(100) + 45 = $9,045. The standard error and the coefficient of determination describe how reliable the line is; they are not terms in it, so neither enters the point estimate.
questions.explanationJa: 数量を式に代入するだけである: y = 90(100) + 45 = $9,045。標準誤差と決定係数は、その回帰直線がどれだけ信頼できるかを表す指標であって式の項ではないので、点推定値の計算には入らない。

questions.stem:
Box Co. uses regression analysis to estimate the functional relationship between an independent variable (cost driver) and overhead cost. Assume that the following equation is being used:
y = A + Bx What is the symbol for the independent variable?
questions.explanation: In y = A + Bx, x is the independent variable, the cost driver whose level is chosen or observed. y is the dependent variable, the overhead cost being predicted; A is the intercept, or fixed component; and B is the slope, the variable cost per unit of driver.
questions.explanationJa: y = A + Bx において、x が独立変数であり、水準が選択または観測されるコストドライバーにあたる。y は従属変数で、予測される製造間接費である。A は切片すなわち固定費部分、B は傾きでドライバー1単位当たりの変動費を表す。

questions.stem:
Sago Co. uses regression analysis to develop a model for predicting overhead costs. Two different cost drivers (machine hours and direct materials weight) are under consideration as the independent variable.
Relevant data were run on a computer using one of the standard regression programs, with the following results:
Machine hours | Direct materials weight
Y intercept coefficient | 2,500 | 4,600
B coefficient | 5.0 | 2.6
R² | 0.70 | 0.50
Which regression equation should be used?
questions.explanation: The coefficient of determination decides which driver to use: machine hours explain 70% of the variation against direct materials weight's 50%. Having chosen machine hours, its own intercept and slope must be used together, giving Y = 2,500 + 5.0X. The wrong answers pair one model's intercept with the other's coefficient.
questions.explanationJa: どのドライバーを使うかは決定係数で決まる。機械時間は変動の70%を説明し、直接材料重量は50%にとどまる。機械時間を選んだ以上、その切片と傾きを組にして使わなければならないので、Y = 2,500 + 5.0X となる。誤答はいずれも一方のモデルの切片と他方の係数を組み合わせたものである。

questions.stem:
What measures might appear on a balanced scorecard?
Quick ratio | Number of customer
returns
questions.explanation: The scorecard deliberately spans four perspectives, so both belong. The quick ratio is a financial measure and customer returns is a customer measure, and it is precisely this pairing of financial with nonfinancial indicators that distinguishes the scorecard from conventional reporting.
questions.explanationJa: スコアカードは意図的に4つの視点にまたがるので、どちらも該当する。当座比率は財務の指標、顧客からの返品件数は顧客の指標であり、財務指標と非財務指標をこのように並べることこそが、従来型の報告との違いである。

questions.stem: The benefits of a just-in-time system for raw materials usually include

choices.label: B
choices.text: Increase in the number of suppliers, thereby ensuring competitive bidding

choices.label: C
choices.text: Maximization of the standard delivery quantity, thereby lessening the paperwork for each delivery

choices.label: D
choices.text: Decrease in the number of deliveries required to maintain production

questions.explanation: JIT removes the activities the customer does not pay for, above all storage and the handling that surrounds it. The other three run the wrong way: JIT works with fewer suppliers in closer partnership, and it makes deliveries smaller and more frequent, not larger and fewer.
questions.explanationJa: JITは、顧客が対価を払わない活動、とりわけ保管とそれに伴う運搬を取り除く。他の3つは方向が逆である。JITはより少数の供給業者とより緊密に組み、納入は大口・低頻度ではなく小口・高頻度になる。

questions.stem:
Nonfinancial performance measures are important to engineering and operations managers in assessing the quality levels of their products. Which of the following indicators can be used to measure product quality?
I. Returns and allowances
II. Number and types of customer complaints III. Production cycle time
questions.explanation: Returns and customer complaints both signal that the product failed to meet expectations, so they measure quality. Production cycle time measures how fast the process runs, which is efficiency; a fast process can still produce defects. Note that the source material prints item I as "returns and no allowances", evidently a typo for "returns and allowances".
questions.explanationJa: 返品と顧客からの苦情は、いずれも製品が期待に応えられなかったことを示すシグナルなので、品質を測る指標である。製造サイクルタイムが測るのは工程の速さ、すなわち効率であり、速い工程でも不良は出る。なお教材はIを「returns and no allowances」と印字しているが、これは「returns and allowances」の誤植と見られる。

questions.stem:
Bell Co. changed from a traditional manufacturing philosophy to a just-in-time philosophy. What are the expected effects of this change on Bell's inventory turnover and inventory as a percentage of total assets reported on Bell's balance sheet?
Inventory | Inventory
turnover | percentage
questions.explanation: Inventory turnover = cost of goods sold / average inventory, so cutting inventory while sales continue raises the ratio. The same reduction shrinks the inventory balance on the balance sheet, so inventory as a percentage of total assets falls.
questions.explanationJa: 棚卸資産回転率 = 売上原価 ÷ 平均在庫 なので、売上を維持したまま在庫を減らせば比率は上昇する。同じ削減が貸借対照表の在庫残高を縮めるため、総資産に占める在庫の割合は低下する。

questions.stem: Which of the following is generally not included in cost/cycle time analysis task categories?
questions.explanation: Cost and cycle time analysis sorts each task into real value, work the customer pays for; business value, work the firm needs even though the customer does not value it, such as accounting and compliance; and no value, pure waste. Priority is not one of the categories.
questions.explanationJa: 原価・サイクルタイム分析は各作業を3つに仕分ける。顧客が対価を払う real value、顧客は価値を認めないが企業に必要な業務である business value（会計や法令遵守など）、そして純粋な無駄である no value である。優先度（priority）はこの分類に含まれない。

questions.stem: Which of the following nonvalue-added costs associated with manufactured work in process inventory is most significant?

choices.label: A
choices.text: The cost of materials that cannot be traced to any individual product

choices.label: B
choices.text: The cost of labor that cannot be traced to any individual product

choices.label: C
choices.text: The cost of moving, handling, and storing any individual product

choices.label: D
choices.text: The cost of additional resources consumed to produce any individual product

questions.explanation: Moving, handling, and storing consume labour, space, and equipment while changing the product in no way the customer would pay for, and in a work in process inventory they are the dominant non-value-added cost. The other three describe indirect or additional production costs, which do add value even though they are not directly traceable.
questions.explanationJa: 移動・運搬・保管は、労働力・スペース・設備を消費する一方で、顧客が対価を払うような形では製品を何ら変えない。仕掛品在庫においては、これが非付加価値原価の中心を占める。他の3つは間接的あるいは追加的な製造原価を述べたものであり、直接跡付けられないだけで価値は付加している。

questions.stem: What strategy involves supporting profits during a period of declining sales by limiting discretionary expenditures?
questions.explanation: A profit strategy props up reported earnings during a downturn by cutting discretionary spending such as research, advertising, and maintenance. It buys time, but only by consuming the capacity that would have produced future earnings, so it cannot be sustained.
questions.explanationJa: 利益戦略（profit strategy）は、景気後退期に研究開発・広告・保全といった裁量的支出を削ることで、報告される利益を下支えする。時間は稼げるが、それは将来の利益を生むはずだった能力を食いつぶすことによってなので、長続きしない。

questions.stem: What strategy involves streamlining the company by contraction and consolidation?
questions.explanation: A turnaround strategy keeps the business but shrinks it back to a viable core, cutting costs and consolidating operations. Divestment and sell-out dispose of the business instead, and a captive company strategy surrenders independence to a single major customer.
questions.explanationJa: ターンアラウンド戦略は事業を保持したまま、存続可能な中核まで縮小するものであり、コスト削減と業務の統合を行う。事業売却（divestment）や身売り（sell-out）は事業そのものを手放す戦略であり、キャプティブ戦略は単一の大口顧客に従属して独立性を手放す戦略である。

questions.stem: Which of the following objectives are focused on innovation or creativity?
questions.explanation: Technology leadership means being first with new products and processes, so it is the objective built on innovation. Market leadership is about share, and parenting and portfolio strategies concern how a corporate centre manages a group of businesses.
questions.explanationJa: 技術リーダーシップとは、新しい製品や工程で先頭に立つことを意味するので、革新を基礎に据えた目標である。マーケットリーダーシップはシェアに関するものであり、ペアレンティング戦略とポートフォリオ戦略は、本社が複数事業をどう束ねるかに関する概念である。

questions.stem: Seawall Industries has a decentralized structure and is experiencing concentric growth. Which stage in the organizational life cycle is Seawall most likely experiencing?
questions.explanation: Concentric growth into related businesses, run through a decentralized divisional structure, is the profile of a mature organization: the original business no longer grows fast enough on its own, so the firm extends into adjacent markets while delegating to divisions. A growth-stage firm is still expanding its core.
questions.explanationJa: 関連事業への集中的（コンセントリック）成長を、分権的な事業部制構造で進めるのは、成熟段階にある組織の姿である。本業だけでは十分な成長が得られなくなったため、隣接市場へ広げつつ事業部へ権限を委ねている。成長段階の企業であれば、まだ本業そのものが拡大している。

questions.stem: Which of the following is not an element of the strategic management feedback model?

choices.label: C
choices.text: Initiate corrective action, if actual performance is below target

questions.explanation: The feedback model is the control loop: set targets and tolerances, compare actual with target, and act when the gap is outside tolerance. Reviewing the mission statement belongs to strategy formulation, which is upstream of the loop rather than part of it.
questions.explanationJa: フィードバック・モデルは統制のループである。目標値と許容範囲を設定し、実績を目標と比較し、乖離が許容範囲を超えたら是正措置をとる。使命の表明の見直しは戦略の策定に属し、このループの上流にあってループの一部ではない。

questions.stem:
What is the required unit production level given the following factors?
Units
Projected sales | 1,000
Beginning inventory | 85
Desired ending inventory | 100
Prior-year beginning inventory | 200
questions.explanation: Production = sales + desired ending inventory - beginning inventory = 1,000 + 100 - 85 = 1,015 units. The prior-year beginning inventory of 200 is history and has no bearing on what must be made this period.
questions.explanationJa: 生産量 = 販売量 + 期末所要在庫 − 期首在庫 = 1,000 + 100 − 85 = 1,015単位。前年度の期首在庫200は過去の数値であり、当期に何を作るべきかとは関係しない。

questions.stem:
The flexible budget for a production department may include
Direct labor | Factory overhead
questions.explanation: A flexible budget covers every cost in the department, splitting each into its fixed and variable elements so the budget can be restated at any volume. Direct labour is largely variable and overhead is mixed, and both belong in the budget.
questions.explanationJa: 変動予算は当該部門のすべての原価を対象とし、各費目を固定的要素と変動的要素に分解することで、どの操業度でも予算を組み直せるようにする。直接労務費は主に変動費、製造間接費は混合費であり、どちらも予算に含まれる。

questions.stem: Fargo, Mfg., a small business, is developing a budget for next year. Which of the following steps should Fargo perform first?

choices.label: B
choices.text: Determine the price of Fargo's products

choices.label: C
choices.text: Identify costs of Fargo's forecasted sales volume

choices.label: D
choices.text: Compute the dollar amount of Fargo's forecasted sales

questions.explanation: Sales volume drives everything downstream: production, materials, labour, and ultimately cash. Costs cannot be identified until the volume is known, and although pricing interacts with volume, the forecast of how many units will move is the starting point of the master budget.
questions.explanationJa: 販売数量が下流のすべてを動かす。生産・材料・労務、そして最終的には現金である。数量が分からなければ原価も特定できない。価格設定は数量と相互に影響し合うが、何単位売れるかの予測こそが総合予算の出発点である。

questions.stem: On June 30, Year 3, a company is preparing the cash budget for the third quarter. The collection pattern for credit sales has been 60% in the month of sale, 30% in the first month after sale, and the rest in the second month after sales. Uncollectible accounts are negligible. There are cash sales each month equal to 25% of total sales. The total sales for the quarter are estimated as follows: July, $30,000; August, $15,000; September $35,000. Accounts receivable on June 30, Year 3, were $10,000. What amount would be the projected cash collections for September?
questions.explanation: Split each month into its cash and credit halves. Credit sales are 75%: July $22,500, August $11,250, September $26,250. September receipts = cash sales 25% x $35,000 = $8,750, plus 60% of September credit ($15,750), 30% of August credit ($3,375), and the remaining 10% of July credit ($2,250). Total = $30,125.

questions.stem: When a flexible budget is used, an increase in production levels within the relevant range would

choices.label: A
choices.text: Not change variable costs per unit

choices.label: B
choices.text: Not change fixed costs per unit

questions.explanation: Within the relevant range the variable cost per unit is constant by definition; that is what makes the flexible budget formula work. Total variable cost rises with volume, total fixed cost stays put, and fixed cost per unit therefore falls.
questions.explanationJa: 関連範囲内では、単位当たり変動費は定義上一定である。変動予算の数式が成り立つのはそのためである。変動費の総額は数量とともに増え、固定費の総額は変わらず、その結果、単位当たり固定費は低下する。

questions.stem: Which of the following is the best description of a budget?

choices.label: A
choices.text: A delineation of the scope of operations in terms of products and customers

choices.label: B
choices.text: An expression of the essential reason of an entity’s existence

choices.label: C
choices.text: The rules and regulations that govern the internal management of a corporation

choices.label: D
choices.text: A quantitative expression of the objectives and goals of an enterprise

questions.explanation: A budget puts numbers on the plan: it expresses the entity's objectives and goals in financial and quantitative terms for a defined period. Choice A describes the scope of the business, choice B the mission, and choice C the bylaws.
questions.explanationJa: 予算は計画に数値を与えるものであり、一定期間について組織の目的と目標を財務的・数量的に表現する。選択肢Aは事業の範囲、選択肢Bは使命、選択肢Cは附属定款の説明である。

questions.stem: Mien Co. is budgeting sales of 53,000 units of product Nous for April. The manufacture of one unit of Nous requires 4 kilos of chemical Loire. During April, Mien plans to reduce the inventory of Loire by 50,000 kilos and increase the finished goods inventory of Nous by 6,000 units. There is no Nous work- in-process inventory. How many kilos of Loire is Mien budgeting to purchase in April?
questions.explanation: Production must cover sales plus the planned build-up of finished goods: 53,000 + 6,000 = 59,000 units, requiring 59,000 x 4 = 236,000 kilos. The planned 50,000-kilo drawdown of raw material inventory supplies part of that, so purchases = 236,000 - 50,000 = 186,000 kilos.
questions.explanationJa: 生産量は販売量に加えて製品在庫の積み増し分も賄わなければならない: 53,000 + 6,000 = 59,000単位、必要な原料は 59,000 × 4 = 236,000キロ。原料在庫を50,000キロ取り崩す計画なのでその分が充当され、購入量 = 236,000 − 50,000 = 186,000キロとなる。

questions.stem: The computation of Butte's normal spoilage assumes 10 units in 1,000 contain defective materials, and, independently, 15 units in 1,000 contain defective workmanship. What is the probability that is used in computing Butte's normal spoilage?
questions.explanation: The two defects are independent, so a unit is good only if it escapes both: 0.990 x 0.985 = 0.97515. The spoilage rate is therefore 1 - 0.97515 = 0.02485, which falls in the 0.015 to 0.025 band. Simply adding 0.010 and 0.015 gives 0.025 and double-counts the units that have both defects.
questions.explanationJa: 2つの不良は独立に発生するので、良品となるのは両方を免れた場合だけである: 0.990 × 0.985 = 0.97515。したがって仕損率は 1 − 0.97515 = 0.02485 となり、0.015〜0.025 の区間に入る。0.010 と 0.015 を単純に足すと0.025となり、両方の不良を持つ単位を二重に数えてしまう。

questions.stem: Which technique would be most precise in determining the variable cost component of manufacturing overhead costs?
questions.explanation: Regression uses every observation and finds the line that minimizes the squared deviations, so it makes the fullest use of the data and yields measures of reliability as well. The high-low method uses only two points and can be distorted by an outlier, and a scatter-graph is fitted by eye.
questions.explanationJa: 回帰分析はすべての観測値を使い、偏差の二乗和を最小にする直線を求めるので、データを最も十分に活用し、あわせて信頼性の指標も得られる。高低点法は2点しか使わず異常値に歪められうるし、散布図法は目分量で直線を当てはめる方法である。

questions.stem: Under the balanced scorecard concept developed by Kaplan and Norton, employee satisfaction and retention are measures used under which of the following perspectives?
questions.explanation: Learning and growth covers the people, systems, and culture that make future improvement possible. Employee satisfaction and retention measure whether that human capital is being maintained, and in Kaplan and Norton's causal chain they feed the internal process, customer, and ultimately financial results.
questions.explanationJa: 学習と成長の視点は、将来の改善を可能にする人材・システム・文化を扱う。従業員満足度と定着率はその人的資本が維持されているかを測る指標であり、KaplanとNortonの因果連鎖では、内部プロセス、顧客、そして最終的に財務の成果へとつながっていく。

questions.stem: Which activity generally is categorized as a value-added activity?
questions.explanation: Operating the production equipment is what physically transforms the product, so the customer pays for it. Filing tax returns is a business-value activity required of the firm but not valued by the customer, and moving materials and reworking defects are pure waste.
questions.explanationJa: 生産設備の稼働は製品を物理的に変化させる作業であり、顧客はこれに対価を払う。税務申告は企業に求められるが顧客が価値を認めない business value 活動であり、材料の移動と不良の手直しは純粋な無駄である。

questions.stem: What is strategic planning?

choices.label: A
choices.text: It establishes the general direction of the organization.

choices.label: B
choices.text: It establishes the resources that the plan will require.

choices.label: C
choices.text: It establishes the budget for the organization.

choices.label: D
choices.text: It consists of decisions to use parts of the organization’s resources in specified ways.

questions.explanation: Strategic planning sets the general direction: what business the entity is in and where it intends to go over the long term. Deciding how specific resources will be deployed is operational or tactical planning, and the budget is the quantified expression of those decisions.
questions.explanationJa: 戦略計画は組織の大きな方向性を定めるものであり、自社がどの事業に身を置き、長期的にどこへ向かうのかを決める。特定の資源をどう配分するかを決めるのは業務計画・戦術計画であり、予算はそれらの決定を数量化して表現したものである。
